심연 6층 이상의 고대 석관 및 보물 상자에서 [저주받은][장비명]이 일.en: There is a chance for [Cursed] [Equipment Name] to drop from ancient sarcophagi and treasure chests on Abyss 6F+. Cursed gear cannot be equipped and can be purified at the Armory purification facility with a 50% success rate (destroyed on failure). Upon success, a tier from Common to Legendary is rolled, reviving into masterwork equipment with top-tier god-roll stats of that tier.
